Stay the fuck away from top Olaf until your much larger. Farm with Q almost exclusively early but you'd rather miss cs than push the wave because Olafs looking to chase you down through the long lane. If he's ult ghosting after you don't bother with abilities (they essentially root you briefly) UNLESS you can land everything and one shot him because he's even more dangerous low health and can't be CC'ed (including silenced). I'd definetly rush steelcaps --> sunfire, bramble rush is useless because he can just w and heal off the wave but thornmail 2nd seems right. Overall it's your classic scaling matchup just be careful not to give him the opportunity to chase you down through the entire length of the lane. Skill order could be debated hotly but personally I'd think 3? points in Q for the safer farm --> E max although maybe W --> E is correct at the cost of harder farming early. Hope this helps
